status: Capacity sizing model using public Azure Linux pay-as-you-go VM rates; throughput measurements use separate benchmark configurations.
units: VM RAM: GiB (2^30 bytes); SSD capacity and normalized TB: decimal (10^12 bytes). Both capacity denominators are before database overhead and free-space headroom.

lavik.topology: one primary and one full follower, each co-located with a Meta Raft member; one dedicated Meta-only voter on a third VM. Three Meta voters, two dataset copies.

voterVM.role: Meta control-plane voting and failover coordination; persists Meta state on a managed disk

capacityChart.basis: Capacity-only illustration before overhead; repeats independent three-VM Lavik deployment units (one primary, one follower, one Meta-only voter) for additional capacity. Includes voter VMs in the count.

included: VM compute and RAM for every node, plus the local NVMe included with each of the two L16as_v4 data VMs
excluded: Managed OS/data disks, external backup storage, traffic charges, operations staffing, support, taxes and negotiated discounts
durability: The two data VMs use Azure temporary local NVMe. All three Meta members need durable managed-disk state. Native data replication is asynchronous; external backups remain required.
